description: Implementation of the NotesDao interface using SQLite database; provides CRUD operations and search functionality for note records in an Android application.

classes.name: NotesDaoImpl
classes.description: Provides database operations for notes, including retrieval, search, insertion, update, and deletion.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last updated time descending.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches notes by query across title, content, and tags.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its unique ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: buildListFromCursor
methods.description: Converts a database cursor into a list of NoteRecord objects.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a database cursor row to a NoteRecord object.
